messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's incident — tail latency spikes on /generate around 23:10-23:30. I sketched a remediation plan and SLO/SLA change proposal.

alex: Thanks. Short summary of metric shift? p95/p99 numbers?

maria: p95 jumped from ~120ms -> 280ms, p99 from ~420ms -> 1.1s during the window. Throughput was steady, so looks like queuing + a kernel hot path.

prashant: That matches the traces I saw — KV cache miss storms for long prompts. We had a small config roll yesterday that changed default cache TTL to 0 for a subset. Possible root cause.

maria: Action items I'm proposing:
- A1) Revert cache TTL override for canary (owner: prashant, due: 2024-05-02 EOD).
- A2) Add prefix KV hit-rate panel + p99 servo on the SLO dashboard (owner: alex, due: 2024-05-04).
- A3) Temporary SLO adjustment and error-budget pause policy while we validate (owner: tara, due: 2024-05-05).
- A4) Add recurring alert detect for "sudden tail > 2x baseline" (owner: maria, due: 2024-05-06).

alex: For A2 — here's the PromQL I used to spot the cache effect:```sum(rate(redwood_inference_kv_cache_miss_total{instance=~"lp-.*"}[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_inference_kv_request_total{instance=~"lp-.*"}[5m]))``` will give miss ratio. We can surface 1m/5m ratios.

tara: For A3 — I want to be explicit about temporary SLO: propose keeping p95 at 300ms and p99 at 750ms for 7 days while we validate fixes, and flag any SLA-impacting calls to Sales/Support. Also recommend setting error-budget burn alert to a lower threshold (20%) so we pause feature rollouts if it burns fast.

prashant: Agree with revert + dashboard. I'll also add a canary traffic test to make sure the TTL change is safe. Plan: revert tonight to canary only -> observe 24h -> apply to prod.

maria: Can we get a quick dashboard runbook in the ticket? Minimal owner steps: 1) check prefix hit-rate, 2) check p99 tail on /generate, 3) check GPU queue length. If p99 improved to <600ms after revert, we unpause error budget.

alex: I'll add the panel and a small runbook note. Also adding a synthetic p99 monitor per region (EU/US) to catch skew.

sre-bot: Incident 2024-04-30-2310: status changed to "postmortem-followup". Assigned owners: prashant, alex, tara.

maria: Timeline recap: revert -> 24h observe (prashant), dashboard + alerting (alex + maria) -> SLO adjustment proposal (tara) -> review in SLO governance sync next Tues.

tara: I'll draft the temporary SLO change in the governance doc and include rollback criteria: if p99 > 850ms for >30m after revert, we re-open investigation and escalate.

prashant: Note: I'll also patch the canary job to emit a KV instrumentation tag so we can correlate requests with TTL variant. Helps prove cause.

alex: One more small change: add a dashboard panel showing request size distribution — long prompts correlate with >1k token requests and higher KV churn. Panel owner: alex, due same day as A2.

maria: Cool. I'll create the follow-up ticket and tag owners. Ticket checklist: revert PR, canary job patch, dashboard panels, temporary SLO policy, synth monitors, 24h observation.

alex: acked. I'll ping in #oncall when panels are live. :thumbsup:

tara: acked. I'll prepare governance PR and include exact SLO text.

prashant: acked. Revert PR targeted for tonight's deploy window.

maria: Thanks all — we'll review status in tomorrow's oncall handoff and again during SLO sync.

sre-bot: Reminder: SLO sync meeting scheduled 2024-05-07 16:00 UTC.
